This is a test-store cost; the production persona owner read path is not reproduced locally. The league route already skips route-policy/health/allowed-actions for non-page rows.

persona_fleet.profile: 167 personas, page_size 50, fixture ports: p50 ~0.04 s; cost spread across row projection, no dominant item. Owner reads are already overlapped by BFF-PERSONA-FLEET-CURRENT-LATENCY-20261106.

local_measurement_167_personas_in_memory.caveats: Fixture store reads are in-process and free, so wall time does not change locally; the benefit is the removed 340 store round-trips per request against a real store. Requests were measured sequentially, not concurrently, and persona-health was not timed with 167 real-shaped personas. Acceptance 5 (concurrent p50/p95 incl. persona-health) is therefore only partially evidenced; hosted re-measurement is needed.

constraints: No new cache, setting, endpoint or background job; response shapes unchanged. New tests were added to existing registered files, so no inventory change was needed.
